prs.title: Account for a cloned document's base URL
prs.author: annevk
prs.body:
Define a Document's get the base URL algorithm, used by DOM's baseURI getter, to return the document base URL. Have the document base URL take the base URL override into account, which DOM sets when a document is cloned, so that a clone without a base element reports the base URL of the document it was cloned from. And copy a Document's about base URL when it is cloned, so that a base element in a clone resolves the same way as in the original. Also stop asserting in the fallback base URL, which a Document created by DOMParser in an iframe srcdoc document could trip.

See https://github.com/whatwg/dom/issues/454.

Tests: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/61231 & https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/61232.
